## Instructions for the AI agent

Add Sidebar to this project exactly as specified here.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Components it uses.** Sidebar imports 4 other components. Install them first, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Each doc lists its files; the download script below covers them too.
   - `button`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/button.md
   - `sheet`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/sheet.md

   - `tooltip`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/tooltip.md
3. **Create the files.** Create every file under [Files](#files) at its exact path, with exactly the contents shown. If you can run shell commands, the download script below does this and the step before in one go.
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/avatar.css";
   @import "./components/button.css";
   @import "./components/sheet.css";
   @import "./components/popover.css";
   @import "./components/tooltip.css";
   @import "./components/sidebar.css";
   ```

5. **Usage example only.** The example also renders this component; install it if you use the example as-is (the download script and the CSS lines above include it):
   - `avatar`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/avatar.md
6. **Use it.** `import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGroup, … } from '@/ui/components/sidebar';` See [Usage](#usage). Tell the user which files you created.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Component: Sidebar

App navigation column that collapses to an icon rail on desktop and becomes an off-canvas Sheet on mobile.

#### Anatomy
```
<SidebarProvider open|defaultOpen|onOpenChange storageKey shortcut mobileBreakpoint framed>   div.ui-sidebar-wrapper data-state data-framed data-animate (+ TooltipProvider)
  <Sidebar side collapsible="icon|offcanvas|none">     aside.ui-sidebar data-side data-collapsible data-state="expanded|collapsed" > div.ui-sidebar-inner
    <SidebarHeader> / <SidebarContent> (scrolls) / <SidebarFooter>
    <SidebarGroup> <SidebarGroupLabel> <SidebarMenu> ul > <SidebarMenuItem> li
      <SidebarMenuButton isActive tooltip size="default|lg" asChild?>   button.ui-sidebar-menu-button data-active data-size — icon, <span> label, <SidebarMenuBadge>
      <SidebarMenuSub open|defaultOpen>                                  div.ui-sidebar-sub
        <SidebarMenuSubTrigger tooltip isActive>                         button.ui-sidebar-menu-button.ui-sidebar-sub-trigger aria-expanded aria-controls + chevron
        <SidebarMenuSubContent>                                          div.ui-sidebar-sub-content > .ui-sidebar-sub-inner > ul.ui-sidebar-sub-list
          <SidebarMenuSubItem> li > <SidebarMenuSubButton isActive asChild?>
  <SidebarInset asChild?>                              div.ui-sidebar-inset (main area)
<SidebarTrigger />                                     ghost icon Button, aria-label="Toggle sidebar", Tooltip with "Ctrl B"
useSidebar() → { open, setOpen, openMobile, setOpenMobile, isMobile, collapsed, toggle }
```

#### Behaviour
- State: controlled or uncontrolled (default expanded). `storageKey` (default `ui-sidebar`, `false` = off) persists `"open" | "collapsed"` in `localStorage`; every read and write is in try/catch. It is restored in a layout effect, and the width transition (`data-animate`) turns on two frames after mount so a restored state never animates.
- `shortcut`: Ctrl / Cmd + B toggles (the Sheet on mobile). Ignored in inputs, textareas, selects and contenteditable.
- Mobile (`matchMedia(max-width: breakpoint - 1)`, default 768): `Sidebar` renders its children in a `Sheet` (`side`, size sm, no close button, title "Sidebar" as `sr-only`) and `collapsed` is false. Choosing a menu button closes it.
- `collapsed` = desktop and closed (and `collapsible !== "none"`). Tooltips: the tree never changes shape (focus survives collapsing); a `Tooltip` is held closed (`open={false}`) unless collapsed, then shows the label to the right.
- Sub-menu: the trigger toggles; while collapsed it expands the sidebar and opens the group. Content is hidden with `visibility` after the close animation, so closed items leave the tab order; on the rail it is `display: none`.
- `framed`: the wrapper is `height: 100%`, `overflow: hidden`; the inset scrolls. Full page: sidebar is `sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh`.

#### Visual rules
- Widths `--ui-sidebar-width` 16rem, `--ui-sidebar-width-icon` 3.5rem. Colours: `--ui-sidebar`, `--ui-sidebar-foreground`, `--ui-sidebar-border` (1px on the inner edge), `--ui-sidebar-accent` for the active row, 60% of it on hover.
- Rows: 36px (lg 48px), 12px horizontal padding, 10px gap, 16px icon, 14px, `--radius-md`, nowrap + `overflow: hidden` so the label clips on the rail while the icon stays centred in 56px.
- Group label 12px/500, 66% foreground; collapses to height 0 on the rail, groups then separate with a 1px border.
- Badge: 20px pill, `--ui-primary` at 12%, `--ui-primary-text`. Sub-list: 20px left margin with a 1px `--ui-sidebar-border` rule, rows 32px.
- Focus ring `0 0 0 3px` of `--ui-ring` at 45%.

#### Motion
- Width on `--ui-spring-smooth` / `-duration` (size is the information). Sub-content `grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr` on the same spring; chevron rotates 90° on `--ui-spring-snappy`. Rows scale .985 when pressed. Reduced motion keeps the state, drops the movement.

#### Accessibility
- aside landmark (label "Sidebar" unless given); `aria-current="page"` on the active row; trigger `aria-expanded`; sub triggers `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`.

#### Acceptance checks
- Ctrl + B toggles between 256px and 56px; reload keeps the choice; no animation on load.
- Collapsed: labels clipped, tooltips appear on hover and keyboard focus, and every icon-only row still has its accessible name.
- Collapsing while a row is focused keeps focus on it.
- At 390px the sidebar is a sheet opened by the trigger and closed by choosing a row.
- Works in a 560px framed container and on a full page.

### `ui/components/sidebar/sidebar-context.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { createContext, useContext } from 'react';

export type SidebarSide = 'left' | 'right';
export type SidebarCollapsible = 'icon' | 'offcanvas' | 'none';

export interface SidebarContextValue {
  /** Desktop: expanded (true) or collapsed (false). */
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean | ((prev: boolean) => boolean)) => void;
  /** Mobile: the off-canvas sheet. */
  openMobile: boolean;
  setOpenMobile: (open: boolean | ((prev: boolean) => boolean)) => void;
  /** Viewport is below the mobile breakpoint: the sidebar is an off-canvas sheet. */
  isMobile: boolean;
  /** Collapsed to the rail right now (never true on mobile, where the sheet is always full). */
  collapsed: boolean;
  /** Toggle the desktop rail, or the sheet on mobile. */
  toggle: () => void;
}

export const SidebarContext = createContext<SidebarContextValue | null>(null);

/** State of the nearest SidebarProvider. */
export function useSidebar(): SidebarContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(SidebarContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useSidebar must be used inside <SidebarProvider>.');
  return ctx;
}
```

### `ui/components/sidebar/sidebar-menu.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  forwardRef,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type LiHTMLAttributes,
  type MouseEvent,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from '../tooltip';
import { useSidebar } from './sidebar-context';

export const SidebarMenu = forwardRef<HTMLUListElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLUListElement>>(function SidebarMenu(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <ul ref={ref} className={cn('ui-sidebar-menu', className)} {...props} />;
});

export const SidebarMenuItem = forwardRef<HTMLLIElement, LiHTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>>(function SidebarMenuItem(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <li ref={ref} className={cn('ui-sidebar-menu-item', className)} {...props} />;
});

/**
 * Shows `label` in a tooltip to the right of `trigger`, but only while the
 * sidebar is collapsed. The tree shape never changes (so focus survives a
 * collapse); the tooltip is held closed when it is not wanted.
 */
export function SidebarTooltip({ trigger, label }: { trigger: ReactElement; label: ReactNode }) {
  const { collapsed } = useSidebar();
  return (
    <Tooltip open={collapsed ? undefined : false}>
      <TooltipTrigger asChild>{trigger}</TooltipTrigger>
      {collapsed && <TooltipContent placement="right" offset={10}>{label}</TooltipContent>}
    </Tooltip>
  );
}

export interface SidebarMenuButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  /** Render your own element, e.g. a Next.js `<Link>`, with the button styles. */
  asChild?: boolean;
  /** The current page: highlighted, `aria-current="page"`. */
  isActive?: boolean;
  /** Shown in a tooltip when the sidebar is collapsed to the rail. Usually the label. */
  tooltip?: ReactNode;
  /** `lg` is 48px tall, for a workspace switcher or account row. */
  size?: 'default' | 'lg';
}

/**
 * One row: an icon and a label (and optionally a SidebarMenuBadge). Put the
 * icon first and the label in a `<span>`; the rail clips the label away.
 */
export const SidebarMenuButton = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, SidebarMenuButtonProps>(function SidebarMenuButton(
  { asChild, isActive, tooltip, size = 'default', className, onClick, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const { isMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar();
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button';
  const button = (
    <Comp
      ref={ref as never}
      type={asChild ? undefined : 'button'}
      data-size={size}
      data-active={isActive ? 'true' : undefined}
      aria-current={isActive ? 'page' : undefined}
      className={cn('ui-sidebar-menu-button', className)}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        // Picking a destination on mobile closes the sheet
        if (isMobile && !e.defaultPrevented) setOpenMobile(false);
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </Comp>
  );
  return tooltip != null ? <SidebarTooltip trigger={button} label={tooltip} /> : button;
});

/** A count or status at the end of a row. Hidden on the rail. */
export const SidebarMenuBadge = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>>(function SidebarMenuBadge(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <span ref={ref} className={cn('ui-sidebar-menu-badge', className)} {...props} />;
});
```

### `ui/components/sidebar/sidebar-sub.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useContext,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type LiHTMLAttributes,
  type MouseEvent,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { useSidebar } from './sidebar-context';
import { SidebarTooltip } from './sidebar-menu';

interface SubContextValue {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  triggerId: string;
  contentId: string;
}

const SubContext = createContext<SubContextValue | null>(null);

function useSub(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(SubContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <SidebarMenuSub>.`);
  return ctx;
}

export interface SidebarMenuSubProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  open?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
}

/**
 * A collapsible group of nested items inside a SidebarMenuItem:
 *   <SidebarMenuSub><SidebarMenuSubTrigger>…</SidebarMenuSubTrigger>
 *     <SidebarMenuSubContent><SidebarMenuSubItem>…
 */
export const SidebarMenuSub = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, SidebarMenuSubProps>(function SidebarMenuSub(
  { open: openProp, defaultOpen = false, onOpenChange, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const id = useId();
  const ctx = useMemo(
    () => ({ open, setOpen, triggerId: `${id}-trigger`, contentId: `${id}-content` }),
    [open, setOpen, id],
  );
  return (
    <SubContext.Provider value={ctx}>
      <div ref={ref} data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'} className={cn('ui-sidebar-sub', className)} {...props} />
    </SubContext.Provider>
  );
});

export interface SidebarMenuSubTriggerProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  /** The sub-menu holds the current page. */
  isActive?: boolean;
  /** Shown in a tooltip when the sidebar is collapsed to the rail. */
  tooltip?: ReactNode;
}

/** The row that opens and closes the nested items. Same look as SidebarMenuButton, plus a chevron. */
export const SidebarMenuSubTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, SidebarMenuSubTriggerProps>(
  function SidebarMenuSubTrigger({ isActive, tooltip, className, onClick, children, ...props }, ref) {
    const sub = useSub('SidebarMenuSubTrigger');
    const { collapsed, setOpen: setSidebarOpen } = useSidebar();
    const button = (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        type="button"
        id={sub.triggerId}
        data-size="default"
        data-active={isActive && !sub.open ? 'true' : undefined}
        data-state={sub.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
        aria-expanded={sub.open}
        aria-controls={sub.contentId}
        className={cn('ui-sidebar-menu-button ui-sidebar-sub-trigger', className)}
        onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
          onClick?.(e);
          if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
          // On the rail there is no room for nested items: expand the sidebar and show them
          if (collapsed) {
            setSidebarOpen(true);
            sub.setOpen(true);
          } else {
            sub.setOpen(!sub.open);
          }
        }}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        <Icon name="chevron-right" size={14} className="ui-sidebar-sub-chevron" />
      </button>
    );
    return tooltip != null ? <SidebarTooltip trigger={button} label={tooltip} /> : button;
  },
);

/** The nested items. Their height animates on the smooth spring; closed items are out of the tab order. */
export const SidebarMenuSubContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(
  function SidebarMenuSubContent({ className, children, ...props }, ref) {
    const sub = useSub('SidebarMenuSubContent');
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        id={sub.contentId}
        data-state={sub.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
        className={cn('ui-sidebar-sub-content', className)}
        {...props}
      >
        <div className="ui-sidebar-sub-inner">
          <ul className="ui-sidebar-sub-list">{children}</ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);

export const SidebarMenuSubItem = forwardRef<HTMLLIElement, LiHTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>>(function SidebarMenuSubItem(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <li ref={ref} className={cn('ui-sidebar-sub-item', className)} {...props} />;
});

export interface SidebarMenuSubButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  asChild?: boolean;
  isActive?: boolean;
}

export const SidebarMenuSubButton = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, SidebarMenuSubButtonProps>(
  function SidebarMenuSubButton({ asChild, isActive, className, onClick, ...props }, ref) {
    const { isMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar();
    const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button';
    return (
      <Comp
        ref={ref as never}
        type={asChild ? undefined : 'button'}
        data-active={isActive ? 'true' : undefined}
        aria-current={isActive ? 'page' : undefined}
        className={cn('ui-sidebar-sub-button', className)}
        onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
          onClick?.(e);
          if (isMobile && !e.defaultPrevented) setOpenMobile(false);
        }}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  },
);
```

### `ui/components/sidebar/sidebar.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type CSSProperties,
  type HTMLAttributes,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { Button } from '../button';
import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetTitle } from '../sheet';
import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger } from '../tooltip';
import { SidebarContext, useSidebar, type SidebarCollapsible, type SidebarSide } from './sidebar-context';

export interface SidebarProviderProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Controlled desktop state: true = expanded, false = collapsed to the rail. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Initial state when uncontrolled. Default true. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /**
   * localStorage key that remembers the state between visits, or `false` to
   * turn it off. Reading and writing are wrapped in try/catch, so blocked
   * storage never throws. Default `"ui-sidebar"`.
   */
  storageKey?: string | false;
  /** Ctrl/Cmd + B toggles the sidebar. Default true. Turn off when several sidebars share a page. */
  shortcut?: boolean;
  /** Below this viewport width (px) the sidebar becomes an off-canvas sheet. Default 768. */
  mobileBreakpoint?: number;
  /** Lay out inside a fixed-height frame (a docs preview, a card) instead of the full page. */
  framed?: boolean;
}

/**
 * SidebarProvider — holds the open / collapsed state for Sidebar, SidebarTrigger
 * and every menu button, and lays out the sidebar next to SidebarInset.
 */
export const SidebarProvider = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, SidebarProviderProps>(function SidebarProvider(
  {
    open: openProp,
    defaultOpen = true,
    onOpenChange,
    storageKey = 'ui-sidebar',
    shortcut = true,
    mobileBreakpoint = 768,
    framed,
    className,
    style,
    children,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const key = storageKey === false ? null : storageKey;
  const handleChange = useCallback(
    (next: boolean) => {
      onOpenChange?.(next);
      if (!key) return;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(key, next ? 'open' : 'collapsed');
      } catch {
        /* storage blocked: the state just won't persist */
      }
    },
    [onOpenChange, key],
  );
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: handleChange });
  const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = useState(false);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);
  const [animate, setAnimate] = useState(false);

  // Restore the remembered state before paint, then switch the width transition on
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!key || openProp !== undefined) return;
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (stored === 'open' || stored === 'collapsed') setOpen(stored === 'open');
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }, [key]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let raf2 = 0;
    const raf1 = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      raf2 = requestAnimationFrame(() => setAnimate(true));
    });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf1);
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf2);
    };
  }, []);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${mobileBreakpoint - 1}px)`);
    const read = () => setIsMobile(mq.matches);
    read();
    mq.addEventListener('change', read);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', read);
  }, [mobileBreakpoint]);

  const toggle = useCallback(() => {
    if (isMobile) setOpenMobile((o) => !o);
    else setOpen((o) => !o);
  }, [isMobile, setOpen]);
  const toggleRef = useRef(toggle);
  toggleRef.current = toggle;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shortcut) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (!(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) || e.altKey || e.shiftKey || e.key.toLowerCase() !== 'b') return;
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      if (t && (t.isContentEditable || /^(input|textarea|select)$/i.test(t.tagName))) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleRef.current();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [shortcut]);

  const ctx = useMemo(
    () => ({ open, setOpen, openMobile, setOpenMobile, isMobile, collapsed: !isMobile && !open, toggle }),
    [open, setOpen, openMobile, isMobile, toggle],
  );

  return (
    <SidebarContext.Provider value={ctx}>
      <TooltipProvider delayDuration={250}>
        <div
          ref={ref}
          data-state={open ? 'expanded' : 'collapsed'}
          data-framed={framed ? '' : undefined}
          data-animate={animate ? '' : undefined}
          className={cn('ui-sidebar-wrapper', className)}
          style={style as CSSProperties}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </TooltipProvider>
    </SidebarContext.Provider>
  );
});

export interface SidebarProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  /** Edge it sits on. Default `left`. */
  side?: SidebarSide;
  /**
   * `icon` collapses to a 56px rail of icons (default), `offcanvas` slides
   * away completely, `none` never collapses on desktop.
   */
  collapsible?: SidebarCollapsible;
}

/**
 * Sidebar — the app navigation column. On desktop it collapses to an icon rail
 * (the width animates on the smooth spring); below the mobile breakpoint it is
 * an off-canvas Sheet.
 */
export const Sidebar = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SidebarProps>(function Sidebar(
  { side = 'left', collapsible = 'icon', className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const parent = useSidebar();
  const collapsed = parent.collapsed && collapsible !== 'none';
  const value = useMemo(() => ({ ...parent, collapsed }), [parent, collapsed]);

  if (parent.isMobile) {
    return (
      <SidebarContext.Provider value={value}>
        <Sheet open={parent.openMobile} onOpenChange={parent.setOpenMobile}>
          <SheetContent
            side={side}
            size="sm"
            showClose={false}
            className="ui-sidebar-sheet"
            panelClassName="ui-sidebar-sheet-panel"
          >
            <SheetTitle className="sr-only">{props['aria-label'] ?? 'Sidebar'}</SheetTitle>
            <div ref={ref as never} data-mobile="" className={cn('ui-sidebar-inner', className)}>
              {children}
            </div>
          </SheetContent>
        </Sheet>
      </SidebarContext.Provider>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SidebarContext.Provider value={value}>
      <aside
        ref={ref}
        aria-label="Sidebar"
        data-side={side}
        data-collapsible={collapsible}
        data-state={collapsed ? 'collapsed' : 'expanded'}
        className={cn('ui-sidebar', className)}
        {...props}
      >
        <div className="ui-sidebar-inner">{children}</div>
      </aside>
    </SidebarContext.Provider>
  );
});

export const SidebarHeader = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function SidebarHeader(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-sidebar-header', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** The scrolling middle of the sidebar. */
export const SidebarContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function SidebarContent(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-sidebar-content', className)} {...props} />;
});

export const SidebarFooter = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function SidebarFooter(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-sidebar-footer', className)} {...props} />;
});

export const SidebarGroup = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function SidebarGroup(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-sidebar-group', className)} {...props} />;
});

export interface SidebarGroupLabelProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  asChild?: boolean;
}

/** A small heading above a group. Fades out when the sidebar is collapsed. */
export const SidebarGroupLabel = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, SidebarGroupLabelProps>(function SidebarGroupLabel(
  { asChild, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'div';
  return <Comp ref={ref as never} className={cn('ui-sidebar-group-label', className)} {...props} />;
});

export interface SidebarInsetProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  /** Render your own element, e.g. `<SidebarInset asChild><main>…</main></SidebarInset>`. */
  asChild?: boolean;
}

/** The main area next to the sidebar. Scrolls on its own inside a framed provider. */
export const SidebarInset = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SidebarInsetProps>(function SidebarInset(
  { asChild, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'div';
  return <Comp ref={ref as never} className={cn('ui-sidebar-inset', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** The button that collapses / expands the sidebar (opens the sheet on mobile). */
export const SidebarTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>(
  function SidebarTrigger({ className, onClick, children, ...props }, ref) {
    const { toggle, open, openMobile, isMobile } = useSidebar();
    return (
      <Tooltip>
        <TooltipTrigger asChild>
          <Button
            ref={ref}
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            icon
            aria-label="Toggle sidebar"
            aria-expanded={isMobile ? openMobile : open}
            className={cn('ui-sidebar-trigger', className)}
            onClick={(e) => {
              onClick?.(e);
              if (!e.defaultPrevented) toggle();
            }}
            {...props}
          >
            {children ?? <Icon name="panel-left" size={18} />}
          </Button>
        </TooltipTrigger>
        <TooltipContent shortcut="Ctrl B">Toggle sidebar</TooltipContent>
      </Tooltip>
    );
  },
);
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';

/** useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server (no SSR warning). */
export const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/slot.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Children,
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

### `ui/styles/components/sidebar.css`

```css
/* Sidebar -----------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-sidebar-wrapper" data-state="expanded|collapsed" data-framed? data-animate>
     <aside class="ui-sidebar" data-side data-collapsible="icon|offcanvas|none" data-state>
       <div class="ui-sidebar-inner">
         .ui-sidebar-header / .ui-sidebar-content (scrolls) / .ui-sidebar-footer
         .ui-sidebar-group > .ui-sidebar-group-label + ul.ui-sidebar-menu
           li.ui-sidebar-menu-item > .ui-sidebar-menu-button[data-active][data-size]
                                      svg + span + .ui-sidebar-menu-badge
           li > .ui-sidebar-sub[data-state] > .ui-sidebar-sub-trigger
                                            + .ui-sidebar-sub-content > .ui-sidebar-sub-inner > ul.ui-sidebar-sub-list
     <div class="ui-sidebar-inset">
   Widths: --ui-sidebar-width (16rem) and --ui-sidebar-width-icon (3.5rem). The
   width animates on the smooth spring once data-animate is set (never on load).
   Rows clip their label on the rail, so nothing reflows while the width moves.
   Mobile: the same children render inside a Sheet (.ui-sidebar-sheet).
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-sidebar-wrapper {
    --ui-sidebar-width: 16rem;
    --ui-sidebar-width-icon: 3.5rem;
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100svh;
    background: var(--ui-background);
  }
  .ui-sidebar-wrapper[data-framed] { position: relative; min-height: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }

  .ui-sidebar {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    flex: none;
    align-self: flex-start;
    width: var(--ui-sidebar-width);
    height: 100svh;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--ui-sidebar-border);
    background: var(--ui-sidebar);
    color: var(--ui-sidebar-foreground);
  }
  .ui-sidebar-wrapper[data-framed] .ui-sidebar { position: relative; align-self: stretch; height: auto; }
  .ui-sidebar[data-side="right"] { order: 2; border-inline-end: 0; border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--ui-sidebar-border); }
  .ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="icon"][data-state="collapsed"] { width: var(--ui-sidebar-width-icon); }
  .ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="offcanvas"][data-state="collapsed"] { width: 0; border-width: 0; }
  .ui-sidebar-wrapper[data-animate] .ui-sidebar {
    transition: width var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth);
  }

  .ui-sidebar-inner { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; }
  /* An off-canvas sidebar keeps its full width while it slides away, then leaves the tab order */
  .ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="offcanvas"] .ui-sidebar-inner { width: var(--ui-sidebar-width); }
  .ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="offcanvas"][data-state="collapsed"] .ui-sidebar-inner {
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: visibility 0s linear var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration);
  }

  .ui-sidebar-header, .ui-sidebar-footer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: none; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-sidebar-content {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
  }
  .ui-sidebar-header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-sidebar-border); }
  .ui-sidebar-footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-sidebar-border); }

  .ui-sidebar-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
  .ui-sidebar-group-label {
    flex: none;
    height: 2rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-sidebar-foreground) 66%, var(--ui-sidebar));
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition: opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard), height var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard), padding var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-sidebar[data-state="collapsed"] .ui-sidebar-group-label { height: 0; padding-top: 0; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  .ui-sidebar[data-state="collapsed"] .ui-sidebar-group + .ui-sidebar-group {
    margin-top: 0.375rem;
    padding-top: 0.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-sidebar-border);
  }

  .ui-sidebar-menu { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.125rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
  .ui-sidebar-menu-item { position: relative; min-width: 0; }

  .ui-sidebar-menu-button {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.625rem;
    width: 100%;
    height: 2.25rem;
    padding-inline: 0.75rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: var(--ui-sidebar-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    text-align: start;
    text-decoration: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-sidebar-menu-button > .ui-icon { flex: none; }
  .ui-sidebar-menu-button[data-size="lg"] { height: 3rem; padding-inline: 0.25rem; gap: 0.625rem; }
  .ui-sidebar-menu-button:active { transform: scale(0.985); }
  .ui-sidebar-menu-button[data-active="true"] { background: var(--ui-sidebar-accent); font-weight: 500; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-sidebar-menu-button:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-sidebar-accent) 60%, transparent); }
    .ui-sidebar-menu-button[data-active="true"]:hover { background: var(--ui-sidebar-accent); }
  }
  .ui-sidebar-menu-button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }

  .ui-sidebar-menu-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 1.25rem;
    height: 1.25rem;
    margin-inline-start: auto;
    padding-inline: 0.375rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 12%, transparent);
    color: var(--ui-primary-text);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  /* ---- nested items ---- */
  .ui-sidebar-sub-chevron {
    flex: none;
    margin-inline-start: auto;
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-sidebar-sub-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] .ui-sidebar-sub-chevron { transform: rotate(90deg); }
  .ui-sidebar-sub-content {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: 0fr;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: grid-template-rows var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth),
      visibility 0s linear var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration);
  }
  .ui-sidebar-sub-content[data-state="open"] {
    grid-template-rows: 1fr;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: grid-template-rows var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth), visibility 0s;
  }
  .ui-sidebar-sub-inner { min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  .ui-sidebar-sub-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.0625rem;
    margin: 0.125rem 0 0.125rem 1.25rem;
    padding: 0 0 0 0.5rem;
    border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--ui-sidebar-border);
    list-style: none;
  }
  .ui-sidebar-sub-button {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    height: 2rem;
    padding-inline: 0.625rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-sidebar-foreground) 82%, var(--ui-sidebar));
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    text-align: start;
    text-decoration: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard), color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-sidebar-sub-button[data-active="true"] { background: var(--ui-sidebar-accent); color: var(--ui-sidebar-foreground); font-weight: 500; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-sidebar-sub-button:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-sidebar-accent) 60%, transparent); color: var(--ui-sidebar-foreground); }
    .ui-sidebar-sub-button[data-active="true"]:hover { background: var(--ui-sidebar-accent); }
  }
  .ui-sidebar-sub-button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  /* No room for nested items on the rail: the trigger expands the sidebar instead */
  .ui-sidebar[data-state="collapsed"] .ui-sidebar-sub-content { display: none; }

  /* ---- main area ---- */
  .ui-sidebar-inset { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; background: var(--ui-background); }
  .ui-sidebar-wrapper[data-framed] .ui-sidebar-inset { overflow: auto; }

  /* ---- mobile: the sidebar is a sheet ---- */
  .ui-sidebar-sheet { --ui-sheet-width: 18rem; }
  .ui-sidebar-sheet-panel { background: var(--ui-sidebar); color: var(--ui-sidebar-foreground); }
  .ui-sidebar-sheet-panel .ui-sidebar-inner { height: 100%; }
}
```

## Usage

**App sidebar** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/sidebar/app.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/ui/components/avatar';
import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarHeader, SidebarInset, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuBadge, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarMenuSub, SidebarMenuSubButton, SidebarMenuSubContent, SidebarMenuSubItem, SidebarMenuSubTrigger, SidebarProvider, SidebarTrigger } from '@/ui/components/sidebar';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const platform: { id: string; label: string; icon: IconName; badge?: string }[] = [
  { id: 'dashboard', label: 'Dashboard', icon: 'layout-dashboard' },
  { id: 'inbox', label: 'Inbox', icon: 'inbox', badge: '12' },
  { id: 'analytics', label: 'Analytics', icon: 'bar-chart' },
  { id: 'team', label: 'Team', icon: 'users' },
];
const projects = [
  { id: 'projects-all', label: 'All projects' },
  { id: 'projects-starred', label: 'Starred' },
  { id: 'projects-archived', label: 'Archived' },
];
const workspace: { id: string; label: string; icon: IconName }[] = [
  { id: 'billing', label: 'Billing', icon: 'credit-card' },
  { id: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: 'settings' },
];

const titleOf = (id: string) =>
  [...platform, ...projects, ...workspace].find((item) => item.id === id)?.label ?? 'Dashboard';

export default function SidebarApp() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState('dashboard');
  const item = (id: string, label: string, icon: IconName, badge?: string) => (
    <SidebarMenuItem key={id}>
      <SidebarMenuButton isActive={active === id} tooltip={label} onClick={() => setActive(id)}>
        <Icon name={icon} />
        <span>{label}</span>
        {badge && <SidebarMenuBadge>{badge}</SidebarMenuBadge>}
      </SidebarMenuButton>
    </SidebarMenuItem>
  );

  return (
    <SidebarProvider framed storageKey="ui-docs-sidebar" className="h-[560px] rounded-lg border border-border">
      <Sidebar aria-label="Workspace">
        <SidebarHeader>
          <SidebarMenu>
            <SidebarMenuItem>
              <SidebarMenuButton size="lg" tooltip="Acme Inc">
                <Avatar size="sm" shape="rounded">
                  <AvatarFallback>AC</AvatarFallback>
                </Avatar>
                <span className="grid text-start leading-tight">
                  <span className="font-medium">Acme Inc</span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Team plan</span>
                </span>
                <Icon name="chevrons-up-down" className="ml-auto" />
              </SidebarMenuButton>
            </SidebarMenuItem>
          </SidebarMenu>
        </SidebarHeader>

        <SidebarContent>
          <SidebarGroup>
            <SidebarGroupLabel>Platform</SidebarGroupLabel>
            <SidebarMenu>
              {platform.slice(0, 2).map((p) => item(p.id, p.label, p.icon, p.badge))}
              <SidebarMenuItem>
                <SidebarMenuSub defaultOpen>
                  <SidebarMenuSubTrigger tooltip="Projects" isActive={active.startsWith('projects')}>
                    <Icon name="folder" />
                    <span>Projects</span>
                  </SidebarMenuSubTrigger>
                  <SidebarMenuSubContent>
                    {projects.map((p) => (
                      <SidebarMenuSubItem key={p.id}>
                        <SidebarMenuSubButton isActive={active === p.id} onClick={() => setActive(p.id)}>
                          {p.label}
                        </SidebarMenuSubButton>
                      </SidebarMenuSubItem>
                    ))}
                  </SidebarMenuSubContent>
                </SidebarMenuSub>
              </SidebarMenuItem>
              {platform.slice(2).map((p) => item(p.id, p.label, p.icon, p.badge))}
            </SidebarMenu>
          </SidebarGroup>

          <SidebarGroup>
            <SidebarGroupLabel>Workspace</SidebarGroupLabel>
            <SidebarMenu>{workspace.map((w) => item(w.id, w.label, w.icon))}</SidebarMenu>
          </SidebarGroup>
        </SidebarContent>

        <SidebarFooter>
          <SidebarMenu>
            <SidebarMenuItem>
              <SidebarMenuButton size="lg" tooltip="Amina Rahman">
                <Avatar size="sm">
                  <AvatarFallback>AR</AvatarFallback>
                </Avatar>
                <span className="grid text-start leading-tight">
                  <span className="font-medium">Amina Rahman</span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">amina@acme.dev</span>
                </span>
                <Icon name="log-out" className="ml-auto" />
              </SidebarMenuButton>
            </SidebarMenuItem>
          </SidebarMenu>
        </SidebarFooter>
      </Sidebar>

      <SidebarInset className="flex flex-col">
        <header className="flex h-12 flex-none items-center gap-2 border-b border-border px-3">
          <SidebarTrigger />
          <h2 className="text-sm font-medium">{titleOf(active)}</h2>
        </header>
        <div className="grid gap-4 p-6 sm:grid-cols-3">
          {[
            ['Active users', '8,402', '+4.1% this week'],
            ['MRR', '$48,920', '+$2,140 this month'],
            ['Open tickets', '37', '9 waiting on you'],
          ].map(([label, value, note]) => (
            <div key={label} className="rounded-lg border border-border p-4">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{value}</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{note}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <p className="px-6 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Press Ctrl + B to collapse or expand the sidebar.</p>
      </SidebarInset>
    </SidebarProvider>
  );
}
```
